g.text: Should webhook retries use exponential backoff?
Fixed 30s intervals stampede the gateway on recovery. Six attempts
with partial jitter bounds the worst case without dropping deliveries
Agreed. Partial over full jitter is right when ordering matters.
Support. Six is the number the runbook already assumes.
Mine, and I still think it is the smallest change that works.
